title: Silent Focus Sentinel
summary: Flag empty or duplicate label/value text in app-defined iOS XCTest checks.
user: iOS teams who need to catch empty or duplicate labels and values in a chosen XCTest element order before release.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that extracts marked XCTest elements, flags empty or duplicate label/value text, and emits a compact JSON/HTML diff.
success_measure: On a seeded regression suite, it flags at least 90% of intentional empty-text cases with fewer than 10% false positives.
constraints: Keep artifacts local; allow ignored decorative nodes; do not claim WCAG conformance.
